about_the_game:
BOUNCE Up!

Bounce your way to glory in this charming physics-based platformer!

Guide an adorable robot through challenging levels using precise jumps, combining the satisfying physics of mini-golf with precision-style platforming action. Experience the perfect fusion of mini-golf physics and platforming that will keep you hooked for hours.

🎮 Key Features

Massive Content

  • 8 unique worlds to explore

  • 60 meticulously crafted levels per world (480 total!)

  • Each level beatable in just 4 jumps—if you've got the skills

Perfect for Everyone

  • 3 difficulty modes to match your playstyle

  • Easy to pick up, deeply rewarding to master

  • Chill with lofi beats or compete for speedrun glory

Express Yourself

  • Unlock robot cosmetics through pure gameplay

  • No microtransactions—earn everything by playing

  • Customize your bouncy companion

Create & Share

  • Robust level editor with intuitive tools

  • Share your creations with the community

  • Endless replayability with user-generated content

Compete with the World

  • Online leaderboards for every level

  • Track your best times and compete globally

  • Join our Discord community for extra competition and challenges ... with some rewards! 

Addictive "Just One More Try" Gameplay Whether you're perfecting your technique for that elusive 4-jump clear or just bouncing around to relaxing music, Retro Goes Up! delivers that irresistible "just one more level" experience that will keep you coming back.

🤖 About the World

Retro Goes Up! is a spin-off from the upcoming survival game Retro Inc, introducing you to the charming world of Retro Bots.

🎯 Try the Demo!

Experience the bouncy fun firsthand with our free demo! Note: The demo currently supports keyboard and mouse only—controller support is coming soon to the full game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1903 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 (3.1 GHz) / AMD FX-4300 (3.8 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 980 / AMD Radeon R9 390
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Change the Global Illumination settings to OFF if using older cards.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1903 or later)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 (2.7 GHz) / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (3.1 GHz)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / AMD RX Vega 56
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: A physics-based platformer where you guide a bouncing robot through challenging levels using precise jumps. Master 480 stages across 8 worlds, each beatable in just 4 jumps. Features mini-golf physics, 3 difficulty modes, online leaderboards, and level editor.
